title: Lead Backend Developer (Mobile APIs)
text:
Demo Co. Elm is a startup building media apps. We are looking for a lead-level Backend Developer (Mobile APIs) to join our mobile team. Work is two office days a week in Brightwater Bay.

Our stack: kotlin, python, go. You will build offline-first features, review code with the team and improve app performance and stability.

Four-day weeks in summer. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
